mapper.select: SELECT ,a.choice,a.update_time AS answered_at FROM knowledge_question q JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=q.course_id JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id AND e.student_id=#{studentId} AND e.active=1 JOIN sys_user m ON m.id=c.mentor_id AND m.role_id=20 AND m.status='0' LEFT JOIN knowledge_answer a ON a.question_id=q.id AND a.student_id=#{studentId} WHERE c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND q.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.id=#{courseId} ORDER BY q.id DESC

SELECT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_answer a WHERE a.question_id=q.id) AS answer_count FROM knowledge_question q JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=q.course_id WHERE c.deleted=0 AND c.mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND c.id=#{courseId} ORDER BY q.id DESC
SELECT * FROM knowledge_question WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=e.student_id JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=e.course_id JOIN sys_user m ON m.id=c.mentor_id WHERE e.course_id=#{courseId} AND e.student_id=#{studentId} AND e.active=1 AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND m.role_id=20 AND m.status='0'
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_question SET question_text=#{questionText},status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_answer WHERE question_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_answer(question_id,student_id,choice,question_version) VALUES(#{questionId},#{studentId},#{choice},#{questionVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE choice=VALUES(choice),question_version=VALUES(question_version),update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_answer WHERE question_id=#{questionId} AND student_id=#{studentId}

SELECT a.*,s.nick_name AS student_name,s.user_name AS username FROM knowledge_answer a JOIN knowledge_question q ON q.id=a.question_id JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=q.course_id JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=a.student_id JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id AND e.student_id=a.student_id AND e.active=1 WHERE q.id=#{questionId} AND c.mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' ORDER BY a.update_time DESC,a.id DESC
